videos.title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Arc — Official Trailer
videos.description: Ufotable's theatrical trilogy opener gets a full trailer, cutting between the Nakime-controlled shifting castle and the first Hashira matchups. The tag confirms the film's international rollout dates.

videos.title: The Ufotable Animation Team on Adapting the Infinity Castle
videos.description: Key animators discuss how the manga's impossible architecture was translated into continuously moving 2D backgrounds, and why the castle is animated on ones during combat.

videos.title: The Seasonal Roundtable: Fall 2026 Anime Preview
videos.description: A long-form audio breakdown of the autumn simulcast slate, from The Apothecary Diaries' return to the sequels nobody expected to get greenlit. Includes a spoiler-free segment at the top.

videos.title: Every Breathing Style Explained in 12 Minutes
videos.description: A fan-made visual essay mapping the full breathing style family tree, including the derivative forms and which Hashira uses what. Community-produced with manga panels used under fair use.

videos.title: GTA VI — Official Gameplay Deep-Dive Trailer
videos.description: Rockstar's final pre-launch breakdown shows the Leonida map in motion, dynamic weather systems, and the DualSense haptic pass on driving. Two minutes of uninterrupted in-engine footage.

videos.title: Rockstar Developers Break Down Leonida's Dynamic Weather
videos.description: A sit-down with the environmental systems team on how storms propagate across the map, how NPC routines react to them, and what the water engine is actually simulating.

videos.title: State of the Meta: VCT 2026 After the Sentinel Patch
videos.description: An audio roundtable on how the Sentinel utility rebalance reshaped professional compositions, plus a segment on the roster shuffles ahead of the international finals.

videos.title: I Rebuilt Vice City Block by Block in Another Engine
videos.description: A community creator reconstructs the Vice Beach strip from trailer footage alone, comparing each building against the official shots at the end. Built over four months.

videos.title: Avengers: Doomsday — Official Teaser
videos.description: The first footage from the Russo Brothers' next Avengers film, ending on Robert Downey Jr.'s unmasked debut as Doctor Doom. No plot details beyond the Latverian crest.

videos.title: The Russo Brothers on Directing Doom
videos.description: A production interview covering the decision to bring a familiar actor back in an entirely new role, and how the film's practical sets were built around the Doom mask.

videos.title: Box Office Breakdown: The 2026/2027 Superhero Slate
videos.description: An audio deep-dive on tracking numbers, release-date shifts, and what the Spider-Verse and Doomsday openings mean for the next two years of scheduling.

videos.title: Recreating the Spider-Verse Animation Style by Hand
videos.description: A fan animator demonstrates the offset linework, chromatic misalignment, and hand-inked texture that define the Spider-Verse look, then applies it to an original shot.

videos.title: Blade Runner 2099 — Official Trailer
videos.description: Prime Video's sequel series gets its first full trailer, set fifty years after 2049 and introducing a new replicant lineage. Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer lead the cast.

videos.title: Michelle Yeoh on Building a New Kind of Replicant
videos.description: A cast interview on the physical and prosthetic work behind the series' new replicant designs, and how the production approached the franchise's existing visual language.

videos.title: Ten Years of Hollywoo: A BoJack Retrospective
videos.description: A feature-length audio retrospective on the series' structure, its refusal to reset character damage between episodes, and the episodes that still hold up hardest.

videos.title: The Viltrumite War, Explained by Fans
videos.description: A community-produced lore breakdown of the Viltrumite hierarchy, the coalition being assembled in space, and how the animated series is pacing the source material.

videos.title: BLACKPINK 10th Anniversary
videos.description: A short announcement teaser confirming stadium dates and the accompanying anniversary album, closing on a silhouetted stage shot rather than new music.

videos.title: LE SSERAFIM on Preparing for the Dome Tour
videos.description: A group interview covering the rehearsal schedule, the staging changes for a dome-sized venue, and how the setlist was rebuilt around the new album.

videos.title: Random Dance Play Compilation: Best Saves and Fails
videos.description: A fan-edited highlights reel from this year's public random dance play events, cutting between the cleanest saves and the most confident wrong routines.

videos.title: Absolute Batman — Animated Motion Comic Teaser
videos.description: A motion-comic teaser adapting the opening pages of Absolute Batman, animating the modular armour assembly and the axe-emblem reveal. Released alongside the collected edition.

videos.title: Berserk — Memorial Edition Official Trailer
videos.description: The remastered Memorial Edition trailer, showing the reanimated Golden Age footage and the new sound mix. Released alongside the theatrical run.

videos.title: Takeru Hokazono on Drawing Kagurabachi's Sword Choreography
videos.description: A creator interview on panel layout for sword fights, how the enchanted blades' visual effects are kept readable in black and white, and the series' weekly schedule.

videos.title: Weekly Jump Rundown: New Serializations and Hiatuses
videos.description: A weekly audio rundown of the magazine's table of contents, the new serialization round, and which established series are heading into hiatus.
